title: Senior Scientific Data Engineer
description:
About TetraScience TetraScience is the Scientific Data and AI Company building Tetra OS, the operating system for scientific intelligence. We help the world’s leading life sciences firms turn fragmented scientific data into AI-native assets and scientific workflows that accelerate discovery, development, and manufacturing. TetraScience’s growing ecosystem of strategic partners includes NVIDIA, Databricks, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Snowflake, Google, and Microsoft.
 In connection with your candidacy, you will be asked to carefully review “The Tetra Way,” authored by our CEO, Patrick Grady; it is impossible to overstate the importance of this document, and you should take it literally as you decide whether our mission, culture, and expectations are right for you.
 What You Will Do You will join TetraScience's forward deployed teams as a senior, hands-on engineer. In this role, you will work directly with biotech, pharmaceutical, and scientific companies, bringing advanced data and AI technologies into the labs that research, develop, and manufacture medicines. You will work alongside customer scientific, engineering, and IT teams to design, build, and ship integrations and data products on Tetra OS that serve scientific teams across the globe. You will also mentor other scientific data engineers, lead internal design sessions, and partner with Product Managers and Solution Architects to turn customer, product, and engineering objectives into commercialized solutions.
 Act as a forward deployed engineer for a portfolio of biotech, pharmaceutical, and scientific customers. Own the technical relationship, understand their scientific workflows, and deliver solutions that move their programs forward. Drive AI agents to design and build bidirectional integrations between Tetra OS and customer systems such as ELN, LIMS, MES, and process historians, including serverless push and pull pipelines, stateful connectors, and full stack data applications in Python and TypeScript. title: AI & Data Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Bei uns lernst du modernste Technologien rund um Daten und KI kennen , gestaltest von Anfang an mit und wirst Teil eines jungen, dynamischen Teams .
 Über uns Wir sind neonto , ein junges Startup , das Beratung und Softwareentwicklung im Bereich Daten & KI vereint. Unser Ziel: Unternehmen strategisch und praktisch dabei zu unterstützen, Nutzen aus ihren Daten zu ziehen. Wir geben Daten eine Struktur, um sie nachhaltig für KI-Anwendungen und Analytics nutzbar zu machen.
 Unser zentrales Werkzeug dabei sind Knowledge Graphs - eine Schlüsseltechnologie für KI-Enablement, die das Ziel hat, als Single Source of Truth für alle relevanten Daten im Unternehmen zu dienen. Wir arbeiten dabei intensiv mit LLMs.
Unsere Kunden kommen aus Energiewirtschaft, Chemie, Pharma oder Prozessberatung - vom Stadtwerk, das seine Netz- und Betriebsdaten zusammenführen will, bis zum Großkonzern, der Datenprodukte baut.
 Wir sind aktuell zwei Gründer und ein Mitarbeiter und suchen dich als nächste Verstärkung. Bei uns arbeitest du nicht nur an hochaktuellen Technologien, sondern gestaltest auch unsere Kultur, unsere Prozesse und unser Produkt von Anfang an mit.
 Aufgaben Hands-on Entwicklung in nationalen und internationalen Daten- & KI-Kundenprojekten mit klarem Umsetzungsfokus
 Aufbau und Planung von Daten- & Technologiestrategien für unsere Kunden
 Entwicklung von Knowledge Graphs auf Basis offener Standards (RDF, SPARQL, SHACL, OWL)
 Integration von Daten aus bestehenden Systemen (z. B. Datenbanken, GIS, ERP, Dokumente) in eine zentrale Datenbasis
 Entwicklung von maschinenlesbaren Datenmodellen (Ontologien, Taxonomien)
 Umsetzung von Proof of Concepts (PoCs) und Pilotprojekten - vom ersten Workshop bis zur lauffähigen Lösung
 Entwicklung von Ansätzen für neurosymbolische KI (LLMs + Graph Reasoning)
 Mitgestaltung unseres neonto-Toolstacks und der Knowledge-Graph-Applikationslandschaft

title: Team Lead, Data Engineering
description:
We are looking for a Data Engineering Team Lead to lead the Data Platform team at DataSnipper.
 Every decision DataSnipper makes about its products runs through the data platform: which features land, which customers are getting value, what we bill for, what we fix next, and which AI capabilities add the most value. You will lead a team of two data engineers who own the systems that make that possible. That means how usage events get captured across a growing set of products, how they become trustworthy models in Snowflake, and how Customer Success, Product and GTM get to answers without waiting on us.
 This is a player-coach role in a small, high-ownership team . You are responsible for the people, the roadmap and the technical direction, and you stay hands-on enough to ship alongside the team and make architectural calls credibly. At DataSnipper, Team Lead is our entry point into engineering management: the same people, delivery and product responsibilities as an Engineering Manager, on a smaller team.
 We are a handful of people serving the whole company, so your judgment about what not to build matters as much as what the team ships.
 About DataSnipper
 DataSnipper is the driving force behind an intelligent automation platform that’s transforming the world of audit and finance.
 Founded in 2017, DataSnipper has skyrocketed and is now OFFICIALLY the fastest-growing software company in the Netherlands according to Deloitte Fast50 and recently achieved Unicorn status in our latest funding round. With over 400.000 users in 125+ countries and a second base in the heart of New York City, DataSnipper is shaking things up. And we’re not stopping there. At DataSnipper, we’re always on the lookout for innovators who think outside of the box. New ideas aren’t just welcomed at DataSnipper–they’re essential.
 What your team owns
 The Data Platform team works across three areas:

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .
 We are looking for a talented and driven individual to be a key part of our Analytics Engineering team within the Data Science organization. We are looking for someone who can work closely with Data Scientists and Engineers across diverse areas of the organization (Consumer, Ads, and Marketing) to curate, develop, and deploy the right data and analytic tooling to drive Reddit’s product forward and provide a data and tooling foundation that will last decades. Your work will empower thousands of your colleagues to improve the user experience and grow our consumer base.
 Successful candidates have a strong track record of understanding and deeply caring about the purpose of data to support business goals, and can act as an effective conduit between Data Producers and Data Consumers. This role sits at the intersection of Data Science and Data Engineering, and the ideal candidate has skills, experience, and passion in both areas.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Als Senior Data Engineer bij BigData Republic adviseer je toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland over complexe data-vraagstukken. Je combineert hands-on engineering met een adviserende rol: je schrijft productie-klare code, denkt mee over strategische bedrijfsbeslissingen en begeleidt collega’s om naar een hoger niveau te groeien.
 Je hebt je carrière opgebouwd rond het ontwerpen en bouwen van datasystemen. Je werkt graag inhoudelijk mee, maar verliest kwaliteit, schaalbaarheid en duurzaamheid nooit uit het oog. Je bent een ervaren Data Engineer die vaak moeilijk in één functie te vatten is, omdat je op meerdere niveaus impact maakt. En je bent toe aan een nieuwe uitdaging.
 Bij BigData Republic ontwikkelen we data-applicaties, bouwen we data-platformen, creëren we voorspellende modellen en ontwerpen we robuuste data-infrastructuren. We werken vanuit een software-engineering mindset, met focus op technische hoogstaande kwaliteit.
 Kennisdeling en thought leadership vormen de kern van onze cultuur. Elke vrijdag organiseren we kennissessies op kantoor, we schrijven blogs, organiseren meetups en bezoeken en spreken op conferenties.
 Je werkt aan complexe projecten voor grote klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren, terwijl je onderdeel bent van een klein, informeel en hecht team van vakgenoten dat elkaar uitdaagt en inspireert. Bij BigData Republic ben je de expert in de kamer én leer je elke dag van je collega’s. En vooral: je kunt hier jezelf zijn.
 In de praktijk besteed je ongeveer 90% van je tijd aan klantprojecten. De overige tijd is expliciet gereserveerd voor eigen initiatieven: een pet project, innovatie of een idee dat je samen met collega’s wilt uitwerken.
 Je past goed bij deze rol als je ervaring hebt met (een deel van) onderstaande tooling en concepten:
Je hebt een sterke basis in;
 Python
 Cloud (AWS, GCP of Azure)
 Data pipelines bouwen en ouderhouden (ELT/ ETL)
 Data warehousing (Databricks, Snowflake of BigQuery)
 Orchestratie (Airflow, Dagster)

title: Senior Data Engineer, Product
location: Bay Area, CA, United States of America
description:
It all started with an idea at Block in 2013. Initially built to take the pain out of peer-to-peer payments, Cash App has gone from a simple product with a single purpose to a dynamic ecosystem, developing unique financial products, including Afterpay/Clearpay, to provide a better way to send, spend, invest, borrow and save to our 50+ million monthly active customers. We want to redefine the world’s relationship with money to make it more relatable, instantly available, and universally accessible.
Today, Cash App has thousands of employees working globally across office and remote locations, with a culture geared toward innovation, collaboration and impact. We’ve been a distributed team since day one, and many of our roles can be done remotely from the countries where Cash App operates. No matter the location, we tailor our experience to ensure our employees are creative, productive, and happy.
 The Role
 As a Data Engineer, you will handle everything from data architecture and modeling to data pipeline tooling and dashboarding. You will enable a range of other engineering and business teams to make impactful business decisions by laying the foundation of our large and unique datasets that span across multiple products. This role will support the product data engineering team.
 The Product Data Engineering Team at Block builds and maintains the curated data foundation that powers all of Block's product lines — Cash App, Square, Afterpay, and Tidal. We transform raw event streams, transactional systems, and operational data into governed, tested, and reliable analytical assets across domains including banking, lending, commerce, investing, checkout, and AI assistants. We partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, and Applied AI teams to deliver the metrics, experimentation frameworks, and ML-ready datasets that enable Block's products to grow, improve, and serve customers at scale.

title: Analytics Engineer II
description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
 Financial Systems owns the data and reporting foundation for Accounting, and the operational reliability of the pipelines that power reporting, reconciliations, and automation. We are building a single source of truth for financial information using dbt and Snowflake to enable scalable BI and process automation across the org.
 We are hiring an Analytics Engineer focused on maintaining and optimizing our finance data platform , improving reliability, efficiency, and performance of our pipelines and core datasets. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys operational ownership, building strong foundations, and making data systems easier and safer to run at scale.
 What You’ll Do
 Build and maintain dbt models and core datasets that support Accounting reporting and downstream automation use cases.
 Improve platform reliability through strong testing patterns, alerting, and runbooks.
 Own and document data pipelines and lineage, ensuring changes are understandable and auditable.
 Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve production data issues, and drive root-cause fixes.
 Optimize performance and cost in Snowflake and dbt to support scaling needs.
 Partner with engineering and business stakeholders to translate requirements into durable, well-tested data assets.
 Contribute to the team’s best practices in version control, code review, documentation, and release hygiene (GitHub-based workflows).

 3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or similar roles working with production data systems.
